$comment: Perf-gate profile of phase P3B (run-perf-gate.ps1 -Profile p3b): the Sigil Voice Engine scorecard with the targets as revised by P3B (vc_opt_plan target_revisions, accepted by the user) and the trustworthy-bench specs of P3B-A (scripts/bench/specs/p3b/a). Call counts are sized for paired statistics (offline repeat 8, paced and contention runs 60 s). The gated metrics default to the headline p95s (per-block compute, model call, RTF, latency): every gated row is one more chance of a false REGRESSED, so stage metrics (content_ms_p95, f0_ms_p95, ...) are gated only when a change targets them (-Metrics). Before / after claims use the interleaved mode (-CompareExe / -CompareVars / -CompareEnv, ABBA, paired intervals; -AASummary sizes the rounds from an A/A session); targets read the median of B's rounds (per metric, never one round) in that mode and the single report otherwise, so a scorecard is one plain run. QOS: 'app' (default: the app's process EcoQoS opt-out, as the voice changer runs) or 'none' (Windows-managed; use it on both sides against an exe that predates engine.qos, such as exe-s0). T2 idle (a) is the offline (back-to-back) row; the paced row is reported next to it because on a real-time cadence the GPU drops clocks between ticks (P3B-A measured 1.1-1.8 GHz SM clock in paced runs vs 2.8 GHz offline). T2 under load (b) gates both the in-process same-EP hammer (h2-load70) and the out-of-process DirectML load (h2-load70-oop, a game's own process and queue). T3 is per EP: DirectML <= 650 MB, CUDA on H2 <= 800 MB with the CUDA context (reported apart as vram_cuda_context_mb). T4 Streamer: RTF p99 <= 0.6 at 120 ms blocks with <= 3.5 cores (fp32). T5 rows are not here: its v2 rows (P3B-B's scorer and fidelity specs) and the v1 continuity rows are added by P3B-I0. T2b gates both the in-process same-EP hammer and the out-of-process load (target revision (b)). KNN_INDEX needs make-synthetic-index.py.
